description:
Use this when the user asks for the price, trading volume, 52-week range, PE or PB of an Indian company listed on NSE or BSE. Prices are end-of-day, not live. Not for non-Indian stocks or live intraday prices.

Returns the latest close with open, high, low, volume, turnover, market cap, P/E, P/B, the 52-week high and low, and recent dividends. `query` is an NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code. `as_of` is the trading day the quote is from. For several stocks use get_batch_quotes; for past prices, get_price_history; for P/E or P/B over time, get_valuation_history.

query.description: One company: NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code, e.g. TCS, INE467B01029 or 532540. Always send it as `query` (not `symbol`).
query.title: Query

name: get_stock_quote
title: Stock quote (end-of-day)
